description: Crypto PAPER wiring v2 (build plan PR3): decision snapshot /4 binds the CRYPTO_PAPER_RUNTIME_V1 decision and the crypto rotation confirmation packet as sources and requests promotion contract/3 and buy eligibility contract/3; the runtime bridge emits crypto_paper_runtime_request/4 (session budget allocation, marketable limit with the ratified 150bp actual-notional slippage quantity reduction, exit-policy sell requests). Every number is read from config/rule_registry_v1.json or an existing repository contract; this file carries no investment number.

decision_snapshot_v4_cutover.source: build plan 2-3 principle 3 and section 6 S1 (T_cut = a 07:00Z after the private runtime reinstall; the pinned server consumes /3 until then)

order_price.source: build plan section 9 CIO note 6 (crypto order = marketable limit on the decision snapshot book, maximum quantity whose actual-notional consumption slippage stays within 150bp, RULE.EXEC.QUALITY_LAYERS.V1 D3); slippage is realized VWAP versus snapshot best price (docs/crypto_paper_simulator_contract.md); level capacity uses the runtime config queue_fraction exactly as the simulator fills

order_sides.source: RULE.EXEC.QUALITY_LAYERS.V1 names orders without a side; exit sells keep their remaining quantity in the persistent paper_exit_intent/1 and continue at the next decision slot

quantity_step.source: execution contract canon 2-2 allocation step 4 (quantities floored to the trading unit; coin 8 decimal places), applied to /4 orders and session budget lines only; level capacity keeps the simulator decimal_scale; a sell of the whole remaining quantity is not floored

sell_order_validity.source: exit sells get one match opportunity at the next capture and are re-sized on a fresh book by the decision after it; slot length = decision/crypto_paper_decision_snapshot.py SCHEDULED_SLOT_MINUTES (the realtime capture cron); expiry = min(slot bound, session order_valid_before = next 07:00Z) so no order outlives its decision cycle (execution contract canon 2-3), and a sell issued in the last slot before 07:00Z is re-issued by the next session's first decision

open_buys_on_exit.source: execution contract canon 1-4 (open buy remainder cancelled before the exit order)

session_budget_nav_mode.source: build plan 2-3 principle 4 and section 9 CIO note 3 (NAV0 = virtual capital + crypto ledger P&L while KR/US hold nothing)

one_allocation_per_session.source: canon 2-3 and 2-4; build plan C2 (block only when the same market and session already has an allocation record). A decision without an allocation candidate writes no record: an empty record would allocate nothing yet close the session (for example before the day's 07:15Z runtime decision publication)

planned_loss_record_basis.source: build plan section 9 CIO note 4 (record-only planned loss uses the shadow 5xATR14 stop distance); RULE.RISK.PLANNED_LOSS_RECORD_ONLY.V1

reentry_packet_id.source: canon 6-1 R1 key = (market, decision packet id, instrument); RULE.EXEC.REENTRY.V1

strength_confirmation_available_at.source: a rotation packet for as-of date D cannot exist before D ends; the earliest bound makes D7 re-entry denials conservative
